quotes.text: Teams is a collaboration hub for real-time work. You use it for chat, meetings, file sharing and project management. It's built for small groups doing daily tasks.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clearly defines the role of Teams as the contrast to Viva Engage.

quotes.text: They're not competing tools. They complement each other. You use teams to get work done and you use engage to build culture, share knowledge and connect across departments.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise recommendation on how Teams and Viva Engage fit together.

quotes.text: Communities are the heart of Viva Engage. They are topic-based or role-based groups where employees connect around shared interests.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the core building block of Viva Engage in one sentence.

quotes.text: Viva Amplify is for corporate communications. It handles campaign management, publishing and reporting for communicators.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Separates Amplify's broadcast role from Engage's conversation role.

quotes.text: Start small by finding or creating one community around a topic you care about. Post something and see what happens.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical, low-barrier advice for getting started with Viva Engage.

chapters.title: Intro: what Viva Engage is and why it matters
Where Engage fits in the Viva suite

takeaways: Viva Engage is the evolution of Yammer into the Microsoft Viva family, adding deeper integration with Teams, SharePoint and the other Viva apps.
Teams is for real-time work in small groups, while Engage is a company-wide, asynchronous space for communities, storylines, campaigns and events.
Basic Engage features come with most Microsoft 365 business plans, while premium features such as advanced analytics, campaigns and leadership corner need an additional Viva license.
hook: Many organizations still confuse Viva Engage with Yammer or Microsoft Teams and miss its value for culture and knowledge sharing. This episode helps IT pros, communicators and leaders understand what Engage is, how communities, storylines and campaigns work, and how to start with the licenses they already have.
